title: Large-scale typed SSA online decoding evaluation

attestation.dev30_used_for_tuning: the 30 development samples from 7C-1 (all tuning of COMMENT_CAP, EOS gate, cache keys, allowed-char sets happened there)
attestation.g3_type_list_source: ISA signatures (src/isa/registry.py) + input-type literals observed across data/compiler_corpus_v4 + spec scalars; frozen in code at 3b3977c

arms.G1: level 1 - grammar FSM + EOS gate + comment cap (COMMENT_CAP=800)
arms.G2a: level 2 - G1 + defined-before-use + arity cap + duplicate-def forced extension (max 8)
arms.G2: level 3 - G2a + Skill-ISA type preference (identical behavior to 7C-1 G2; level constant refactor only)
arms.G3: level 4 - G2 + canonical input-type literal trie (name normalization only; no semantic-compatibility claim)

fsm_parameters.deadlock_policy: return UNMASKED scores (best-effort; every event logged and reported as a rate)
fsm_parameters.eos_policy: legal only with >=1 node and a completed return reference (trailing newline not required)

decoding.strategy: greedy (do_sample=False), max_new_tokens=512, prompt max_length=2048, batch=1 (all arms)
decoding.prompt: SYSTEM_PROMPT from src/compiler/prompt_format.py + task + gold capability blocks (identical to 7C-0.1/7C-1)

datasets.development_30: first 30 gold-bearing tasks in data/phase6b_resolver/common_eval_tasks.jsonl (13 tbs + 17 xlam); includes ALL 30 tbs tasks in the matched set
datasets.confirmation_150: data/phase7/confirmation_ids.json - held-out-from-decoder-development, ORACLE-CAPABILITY-CONDITIONED (gold capability blocks supplied; Composer isolated): stratified by source x ref-opseq-depth, random.seed(20261009), drawn from the 964 remaining xlam-only tasks
datasets.confirmation_limitation: the 964-task pool is entirely xlam; all tbs tasks were consumed by dev-30, so the confirmation set cannot cover the tbs distribution. tbs evidence remains dev-30-only.
datasets.error_stratification_note: error-type stratification is not computable a priori on unrun samples; approximated by source (which carried the dev-30 error profile)
datasets.claim_scope: results establish: with oracle-selected capabilities, online constraints improve TaskIR Composer structural and op-sequence accuracy. NOT claimed: cross-domain generalization, full-pipeline (Canonicalizer->Resolver->Composer) accuracy, or task execution success

metrics.primary: Valid AND OpSeq (E2E); invalid programs score 0
secondary: Skill F1 E2E (multiset over policy-op-filtered ops)
Param-key Jaccard E2E (fixed full-set denominator; conditional variant reported separately; pairing over filtered node sequence)

reporting_policy.all_994: descriptive only, never described as untouched
reporting_policy.note: all-994 merge deferred until confirmation shows no severe degradation (advisor Task 5 gate)
reporting_policy.statistical_caveats: 3 training seeds only: report as 'reduced dispersion across the three tested seeds', not universal variance-halving; cross-seed records share the same 150 tasks -> task-clustered bootstrap in results/phase7/clustered_statistics.json; Holm-adjusted p-values for the pre-registered contrasts; G2-G1 is a post-hoc composite
reporting_policy.latency_wording: strong seeds show ZERO ACCURACY REGRESSION, not zero runtime overhead - the mask is computed every step (1.8x P50); optimization is Task 5 of 7C-2.1
